summary: Grey sprites in the grid are recolored based on matching their hole count to legend shapes, where each legend shape has a specific color and hole count.
src: grey sprites scattered in the grid s
dst: colored legend shapes in the top-left corner d
symbol_instructions: legend shapes (colored sprites at grid edge) define color assignment: count holes in each legend shape; grey sprites with same hole count get recolored to that legend's color
notes: The difficulty lies in counting holes in each shape
